svg.text: Calling-Order Aligned Architecture & User Call Sites (Detailed Pipeline)

g.text: Parse GUI setup XML & model flags
Select flow, turbulence, thermal & physics models
Set relaxation, time schemes, constants & tolerances
Configure AMG, BiCGStab, GMRES, PETSc / HYPRE
Conclude equation setup, matrix tuning & probes
Mesh file reading & Cartesian mesh generation
Specify input mesh files, formats & scaling
Detect degenerate cells, warped faces & bad angles
Load restart checkpoint variables & time counters
Prescribe initial u, p, T, turbulent quantities & scalars
Prescribe cell fluid volume fraction & drag
CFL / Fourier time step control & adaptive refinement
Update fluid density, viscosity, Cp & conductivity
Anisotropic quadratic head loss tensor evaluation
Define directional resistance tensor Kij in zones
Set inlet profiles, wall temperatures & outlet values
Assemble momentum matrix & solve predicted velocity
Invert Poisson matrix via Multigrid AMG / CG
Update face mass fluxes to guarantee mass conservation
Velocity correction using pressure gradient & residuals
Solve RANS (k-eps, Rij, v2-f) or LES subgrid equations
Custom sources for k, epsilon, omega or Rij equations
Define wall emissivity, absorption & boundary flux
Convection-diffusion solves for thermal & user scalars
Explicit and implicit source terms for scalars & enthalpy
Integrate particle tracking, drag & wall deposition
Prescribe particle rebound, fouling & injection forces
Accumulate statistical means, variances & Reynolds stresses
Post-step monitoring, online integrals & calculation steering
Write EnSight, MED, CGNS visualization & probes
Calculate & export custom derived fields on meshes
Clean Finalization, deallocate SLES, matrices & MPI
Print balance sheets, close custom files & free user memory
